title: Passenger Names on Crestline Tickets: Corrections and Non-Transferability
content:
**Conditions of carriage — the named passenger, Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** A ticket is issued to one named passenger and can never be transferred to another person, except a ticket booked under a corporate agreement whose tier allows reassignment under the corporate-agreement rule.

## Correcting the name

The passenger name may be corrected to match the passenger's government ID in either of two cases:

1. the correction changes no more than the fare brand's name correction limit of characters in total; or
2. the passenger's legal name changed after issue and the customer profile name already shows the new legal name.

A permitted correction is free. A name correction is made only while the ticket is held or ticketed.

## Requests that are refused

A request that would change the person travelling, or that exceeds the character limit without a legal name change shown on the profile, is refused, and the customer may cancel under the cancellation rules instead.

| Hypothetical request (limit of 3 characters) | Ticket status | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| "Jon" to "John", 1 character | Ticketed | Corrected free |
| Surname changed after marriage, profile already shows the new legal name | Ticketed | Corrected free |
| Surname changed, profile still shows the old name, 7 characters differ | Ticketed | Refused |
| Different person to travel on the ticket | Ticketed | Refused |
| 2-character correction | Partially flown | Not made; corrections only while held or ticketed |
